ns2:section.sectionText: This course focuses on the theory and mathematical foundations behind advanced machine learning methods, and their applications on CEE problems. Topics include regression, Bayesian inference, deep neural networks, physics-based deep learning, and Gaussian Processes. Prerequisite: CEE 498 Data Science for CEE Students in this section will complete this course completely online except for the following which must be completed on-campus: Exams (will be completed in the classroom with the instructor/TA), Homework/exam sessions, Office Hours. Contact Becky Stillwell (rborden@illinois.edu), Meg Griffin (mgriffn@illinois.edu), and the course instructor for permission to register.
